releases.name: v0.1.6 - Rename to opencode-adversarial-cooperation
releases.body:
## opencode-adversarial-cooperation

This release renames the project from `opencode-plus` to `opencode-adversarial-cooperation` and refocuses the plugin around [Block AI Research's "Adversarial Cooperation in Code Synthesis"](https://block.xyz/documents/adversarial-cooperation-in-code-synthesis.pdf) paper.

### Changes

- **Renamed** project from `opencode-plus` to `opencode-adversarial-cooperation` across all files, configs, and documentation
- **Rewrote README** to focus on adversarial cooperation concepts: the six principles, dialectical autocoding, and how the plugin implements them
- **Removed MCP/Bright Data integration** from config schema, loader, and agent tool lists — this is out of scope for the plugin
- **Updated agent tool configs** from explicit allowlists to deny-only pattern, so agents can use any MCP tools available in the user's OpenCode environment (webfetch, Context7, Bright Data, etc.) without us managing those integrations
- **Deprecated** the old `opencode-plus` npm package — users should install `opencode-adversarial-cooperation` instead
- **Removed** old banner image

### Migration

```diff
- "plugin": ["opencode-plus"]
+ "plugin": ["opencode-adversarial-cooperation"]
```

Config files should be renamed:
```diff
- opencode-plus.json
+ opencode-adversarial-cooperation.json
```

### Links

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-adversarial-cooperation)
- [Block AI Research Paper](https://block.xyz/documents/adversarial-cooperation-in-code-synthesis.pdf)
